title: progressive disclosure
rule: Show only what is needed at the current step; reveal further fields as the user progresses (pages or conditional logic).

citation.source: NN/g — 4 Principles to Reduce Cognitive Load in Forms

pass_when: Only the current step’s needed fields are shown; later or conditional fields appear when relevant.
fail_when: Every possible question is visible at once on a long flow with no paging or conditionals.
overview: Show only current-step fields; reveal later or conditional ones when relevant.
apply_when: Long or branched forms that can page or condition fields.
not_when: Short single-screen forms where every needed field fits now.
agent_hint: Show only needed fields now; reveal later or conditional fields when relevant.
description: Show only what is needed at the current step; reveal further fields as the user progresses via pages or conditional logic. Pass when only the current step’s needed fields are shown and later or conditional fields appear when relevant; fail when every possible question is visible at once on a long flow with no paging or conditionals. Progressive reveal cuts cognitive load on long paths.
